A brand-only review misses daily components; genotype alone does not determine dose or interactions; laboratory review does not establish access to the prescribed regimen. Once-weekly dosing is not universal, Alyftrek skips a dose more than 6 hours late while Trikafta has a distinct morning rule, and established Orkambi does not require an automatic reduction when an inhibitor is added.

The lower-strength regimen is for below 30 kg, omitting evening ivacaftor is not the standard regimen, and using a combination tablet in the evening changes components and dosing.

Twice-weekly two-tablet dosing copies another product schedule; the usual daily two-tablet regimen fails to adjust exposure; every-other-day one-tablet dosing is the Alyftrek moderate-inhibitor schedule. Give the adjusted dose with fat-containing food.

choiceReview.text: Take the missed Trikafta morning dose and omit its evening ivacaftor; skip the missed Alyftrek dose
choiceReview.finding: Supported best answer in this specified context

choiceReview.finding: Specific incorrect premise or inappropriate product action individually explained in rationale

wholeQuestionReview.individualAlternativeReasoning: 3 p.m. minus 8 a.m. is 7 hours. More than 6 hours after a missed Trikafta morning dose, take it and omit evening ivacaftor, then resume next morning. Alyftrek instead skips that missed dose and resumes the next day. Skipping both misapplies the Alyftrek rule, taking all later doses ignores the Trikafta evening omission, and combining morning and evening Trikafta is prohibited.

choiceReview.text: Interrupt Trikafta and promptly assess and follow liver tests; reassess benefit and risk before any restart
choiceReview.finding: Supported best answer in this specified context

The separate above-3-times threshold with bilirubin above 2 times does not negate that rule. Assess, follow resolution, and make an individual benefit-risk restart decision; an automatic one-dose pause is insufficient.

choiceReview.text: Do not rely on the hormonal implant for effective contraception with Orkambi; arrange an appropriate alternative with the team
choiceReview.finding: Supported best answer in this specified context

Route and food do not remove the interaction. Symdeko and Trikafta labeling do not expect reduced hormonal-contraceptive efficacy, so do not transfer this product-specific warning automatically.

choiceReview.text: Concomitant moderate CYP3A inhibition is not recommended below 6 months; obtain a specialist medication plan
choiceReview.finding: Supported best answer in this specified context

choiceReview.text: Reduce Kalydeco to once daily by copying the older-child adjustment automatically

The once-daily modification applies from 6 months, food does not cancel increased exposure, and an adult tablet regimen does not apply to this infant. Arrange product-specific specialist review rather than inventing a dose.

choiceReview.text: If intracranial hypertension is suspected, interrupt the product and arrange prompt medical evaluation
choiceReview.finding: Supported best answer in this specified context

choiceReview.text: Wait until the next routine pediatric cataract examination
choiceReview.finding: Specific incorrect premise or inappropriate product action individually explained in rationale

choiceReview.text: Dismiss the symptoms because baseline eye examination was normal
choiceReview.finding: Specific incorrect premise or inappropriate product action individually explained in rationale

choiceReview.finding: Specific incorrect premise or inappropriate product action individually explained in rationale

wholeQuestionReview.individualAlternativeReasoning: Unusual headache with diplopia warrants prompt evaluation for intracranial hypertension. The labels call for interruption when suspected and follow-up for resolution and recurrence. Routine lens surveillance is not an adequate response, a normal baseline examination does not exclude a new event, and elevated vitamin A can increase risk rather than justify empirical supplementation.

question.question: What is the primary role of a CFTR corrector?
choices: Improve folding and trafficking of selected mutant CFTR protein
Increase opening probability without changing protein trafficking
Guarantee that every CFTR variant produces functional surface protein
Replace genotype and product eligibility assessment
question.rationale: Correctors increase delivery of selected mutant CFTR protein to the surface. Increasing channel opening describes a potentiator; a corrector cannot guarantee rescue of every variant and does not remove genotype or product eligibility requirements.
